extraction.Name: Nettie Turgeon Pete
extraction.Recorded patent: The patent was recorded November 12, 1918; records do not show by whom
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: Nettie E. David and husband, William J. David, conveyed the land by deed to George Pete for a consideration of $5400
extraction.Buyer: George Pete for a consideration of $5400
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612460 was issued December 21, 1917. Receipt for patent was signed by the allottee January 18, 1918. Land described as south half of southeast quarter, northwest quarter of southeast quarter, section 32, township 97, range 71, and northeast quarter of southwest quarter section 26, township 97, range 70. Conveyance dated June 11, 1919. Document also contains partial entry for Allotment No. 3152, John Mullen.
